title: Síncopa as phrase-end spice, not home pattern
summary: Síncopa (syncopated accent displacement) functions as short phrase-end or bridge colour—one or two bars—not as a continuous home groove; Biagi-style 'floor drop' is an accent, not a section default.
engine_hint: Limit sincopa to colour_slots at phrase tails; never assign contrast_drive to sincopa alone for full B sections.
